title: Ant Bailing Medical Health Large Model Family Fully Open-Sourced: Four Models Each Guard a Stage, from Understanding Medical Examination Reports to Blocking Medical Risks
excerpt: At the Ant Afu Healthcare Ecosystem Conference, the Ant Bailing Healthcare Large Model Family announced full open source release, unveiling four models at once—
content_html:
At the Ant Afu Healthcare Ecosystem Conference, the Ant Bailing Healthcare Large Model Family announced full open source release, unveiling four models at once—LingSante-3.1-air-VL, LingSante-3.1-flash, LingSante Pulse, and LingSante MedGuard—covering four key areas: multimodal health information understanding, complex medical reasoning, health prediction, and medical safety protection.

The one most accessible to everyday people is LingSante-3.1-air-VL. It supports understanding of text, images, and video, and can perform comprehensive analysis by combining skin photos, food photos, and physical examination reports; in multiple authoritative medical benchmarks across specialized tasks such as medical imaging reports, skin disease recognition, and medical report interpretation, this model ranks first globally. Its parameter design is also quite clever: it has 124B total parameters but only 5.5B activated parameters, making it small enough to fit on local devices such as laptops—bringing medical understanding capabilities onto users’ own machines so data does not have to leave the device.

The other model, aimed at professional medical institutions, takes a large-and-deep approach. LingSante-3.1-flash has 560B total parameters and supports up to a 1M-token context, allowing it to process large volumes of medical records, examination reports, and medical literature at the same time, and also perform multi-round document retrieval, medical evidence verification, and tool calling. Its greatest strength shows in how it handles cases with incomplete information and unclear conditions: the model proactively determines what information still needs to be supplemented, which conclusions the available evidence can support, and what action should be taken next—like a physician colleague who knows when to speak up and when to remain skeptical.

The remaining two each handle their own area. LingSante Pulse is a health prediction model that supports risk prediction for more than 150 diseases over the next six years, pushing the focus from “treating existing illness” forward to “preventing illness before it occurs”; LingSante MedGuard is a medical safety protection model that can use patient context to identify medical safety, compliance, and ethical risks, and while staying lightweight, it reaches performance on par with leading industry safety models. All four models are fully open source, effectively placing a complete medical AI toolbox—from understanding and reasoning to prediction and protection—directly in the hands of developers and medical institutions.
